## Purpose
Describe the change and link to the accepted milestone/decision ID.

## Changed files
List all paths and why each change was necessary.

## Scientific correctness
- [ ] Prediction targets/labels are stated correctly (or N/A)
- [ ] Citations, metrics and dataset/license claims are verified (or explicitly UNVERIFIED)
- [ ] No new clinical safety/diagnostic assertion is made without evidence

## Engineering review
- [ ] API/interface impacts and version changes are documented (or N/A)
- [ ] Relevant automated tests/CI results supplied (or N/A for planning-only)
- [ ] No unauthorized data, large artifacts, or secrets added
- [ ] All work stays within the explicitly approved phase

## Human approval
- [ ] Scientific/research reviewer approved
- [ ] Backend/AI integration reviewer approved if applicable
- [ ] Repo maintainer reviewed the diff

**Do not merge until human reviewers approve.**
